topic: Adding session duration calibration to models
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on adding a calibration for `session_duration` alongside signal level, company, and category. It was determined that this feature is valuable for model training but might differ from calibrations used in non-model queries (e.g., frequency or conversion).

Regarding technical implementation, it was noted that there is no existing flag to distinguish between online and offline sensor data. A solution requires creating a subquery based on sessions or pings within the last 5 minutes or half an hour.
decisions: Implement calibration for session duration alongside signal level, company, and category.
action_items: Develop a subquery to determine if sensor data is online or offline (based on recent sessions/pings).
